description: This file contains integration tests for the 'Edit' functionality in the 'Articles' feature of the Conduit project. It tests editing an existing article by creating one, then updating its details and tags, and finally asserting the correctness of the update.

classes.name: EditTests
classes.description: An integration test class for the 'Edit' feature in the 'Articles' section, using Xunit for test execution.

methods.name: Expect_Edit_Article
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that creates an article, edits it, and verifies that the changes are correctly applied.
